sources.scope: Observed Xiaomi VIP ioctl ABI and inode flag; independently implemented candidate.

candidates.behavior: Bounded volatile inode registration; selected buffered-read BIOs receive RT I/O priority when vip_file_enable is enabled.
limits: The sysfs switch starts disabled; registrations disappear on unmount.
Both registration and removal require CAP_SYS_NICE. This differs from the original permission policy; callers without this capability receive EPERM.
This is not the unpublished Xiaomi implementation and does not restore Hybrid UFS or prove a performance gain.

sources.scope: SCSI_BATCH_UNMAP per-bio descriptor encoding and VPD capability negotiation.
Corroborates the per-bio UNMAP algorithm; Xiaomi OEM policy is excluded.

candidates.behavior: Encode separate discard BIO ranges in one UNMAP command, bounded by device VPD, CDB length and the one-page buffer; preserve the single-descriptor path.
limits: At 4K page size the payload holds at most 255 descriptors.
This is generic batch UNMAP, not complete Xiaomi FastDiscard: OEM enablement, object lifecycle, controls and statistics are excluded.
Hardware activation and performance remain unverified.

device_observation.effect: This generic candidate retains one descriptor on the observed tablet; it does not activate Xiaomi FastDiscard.
